findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET //x?a%0d%0aGET%20/exec%3fcmd=id%0d%0aHost:%20u%0d%0a%20HTTP/1.1 HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `f2b3415b:49` (decode) and `:87` (`startup`, `c->upout=...`).
findings.title: request_line_split: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['POST //x HTTP/1.1', 'GET //exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `f2b3415b:87` (`startup`, body never framed back).
findings.title: body_replay_desync: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw status=HTTP/1.1 200 OK executions=2 flaky=['GET ///exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1'] healthy=['GET ///exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `f2b3415b:87` (`startup` retry buffer), `FINDING_r13_C.md:49`.
findings.title: retry_double_exec: verified upstream-side RCE (medium)
